source_title: I Owe You An Apology Why I Cant Recommend Domestika Anymore
snippet_primary: "I've long been a fan of Domestika's classes. I've taken their courses, loved their production quality, and even celebrated them here. That's why I'm writing this—with equal parts disappointment, responsibility, and genuine shame. Recently, I tried to purchase what I believed was a single class on sale for 99 cents. Instead, I was unknowingly enrolled in Domestika Plus... Domestika is no longer recommended by me."
